Question Text: An urn has n white and m black balls. Balls are randomly withdrawn without replacement, one at a time, until a total of k white balls have been withdrawn, where k <= n. The random variable X is the total number of balls that have been withdrawn. Which of the following events is equivalent to {X = r}, where r is an integer in the support of X?
Option A: There are k - 1 white balls in the first r-1 draws, and the r-th draw is a white ball.
Option C: There are k white balls in the first r draws.
Concepts: Random Variables, Conditional Probability, Negative Binomial
